title: Namaz of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s)
introduction:
NAMAZ OF IMAM MAHDI (A.T.F.S)

This prayer consists of two units in each of which Surah al-Faatehah is recited once but the following Ayah (verse) is repeated one hundred times:

Then, Surah al-Tawheed is recited once.

After the namaz recite Tasbih of Hazrat Fatima Zahra (s.a.) and recite the dua of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.):

verses.translation: You do we worship, and Yours aid we seek.
